fullPassage: Everything in the world exists on a continuum, whether in speed, size, or any other possible descriptor you could think of. Still, we create and mindlessly adopt sharp distinctions, and those distinctions change lives far more dramatically than marginal differences ever do. Indeed, all differences are arbitrary, but drawing hard lines between categories hides this arbitrariness and can be severely damaging. I call this resulting damage "the borderline effect." The examples are endless. Someone's IQ is 69 and someone else's is 70 — but only the score of 70 is deemed to be within the range of normal. We don't have to be statisticians to know there is not a meaningful difference between 69 and 70. Yet once the person with the lower score is labeled "cognitively impaired," his or her life will unfold differently than the person with a one-point advantage.

Still, we create and mindlessly adopt sharp distinctions, and those distinctions change lives far more dramatically than marginal differences ever do. Indeed, all differences are arbitrary, but drawing hard lines between categories hides this arbitrariness and can be severely damaging. I call this resulting damage "the borderline effect." The examples are endless. Someone's IQ is 69 and someone else's is 70 — but only the score of 70 is deemed to be within the range of normal. We don't have to be statisticians to know there is not a meaningful difference between 69 and 70. Yet once the person with the lower score is labeled "cognitively impaired," his or her life will unfold differently than the person with a one-point advantage.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문 주제: 자의적 경계(borderline)가 초래하는 피해
det.analysis:
❌ ① IQ 테스트의 정확성과 한계 — IQ는 예시일 뿐 본문 주제가 아님
✅ ② 자의적 경계가 초래하는 피해와 그 문제점 — 자의적 구분이 삶을 극적으로 바꾸고 borderline effect를 일으킨다는 핵심 주제 ←정답
❌ ③ 통계학자의 역할과 범주 분류의 필요성 — 통계학자는 비유적으로 언급될 뿐
❌ ④ 인지 장애 판정 기준의 과학적 근거 — 판정 기준의 문제점을 지적할 뿐 과학적 근거는 다루지 않음
det.tip: 본문의 핵심 용어 borderline effect와 연결하세요.
